# rusolve

> A Rust LP/MIP solver built to be driven by AI agents: a CLI whose `--format json` output is one versioned JSON object, an MCP server (`rusolve-cli mcp`), model diagnostics by name (infeasibility, lint, ranging, repair), and a registry of every option and environment variable. The MIP engine is a faithful Rust port of HiGHS 1.16.

Use the MCP server when you can, the CLI otherwise. Both return the same JSON. Names (rows, columns) appear everywhere instead of indices. Exit codes: 0 ran (read the status in the output), 2 usage error, 3 input error, 4 internal error.

## Start here

- Install: [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) is written for an agent: it picks the route, installs the binary, registers the MCP server and the skills, and verifies it, without questions beyond the optional CP-SAT engine.
- Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CREAIT-nl/rusolve/main/install.sh | sh` puts `rusolve-cli` in `~/.local/bin` (Linux, macOS); add `--with-cpsat` for the optional CP-SAT engine; `pip install rusolve` remains the Python route. See [docs/design/install.md](docs/design/install.md).
- [Install](README.md#install): `uvx --from rusolve rusolve mcp` runs the MCP server from the Python wheel (which also provides the `rusolve` CLI); `cargo install --git <repo> rusolve-cli --locked` for the CLI alone.
- [README, agent section](README.md#for-agents): build, MCP config, the five-minute path.
- [Generated reference](docs/agent/reference.md): every command, MCP tool, option (with range and default) and environment variable. Generated from the binary by `tools/gen_agent_docs.py`; never stale.
- [MCP server design](docs/design/mcp.md): tools, model handles, protocol notes.
- [Python package](crates/rusolve-py/README.md): `import rusolve as rs; m = rs.Model()`, models from dicts, numpy, scipy.sparse or expressions; `rusolve.scipy.milp`/`linprog` for SciPy code. Spec: [python-api.md](docs/design/python-api.md).
- [Python general constraints](crates/rusolve-py/README.md#general-constraints): `m.add_indicator`, `add_sos1`/`add_sos2`, `add_pwl`, `add_abs`, `add_max`, `add_min`, `add_and`, `add_or`, `add_not` (no big-M by hand; `sol.general_constraints["verified"]`). A quadratic objective is `m.set_quadratic_objective`; quadratic constraints and cones are not in the Python API.
- [Scheduling objects](docs/design/cp-model.md): `m.add_interval`, `add_no_overlap`, `add_cumulative`, `add_all_different`, `add_element`, `add_table` (Python and MCP `build_model` `cp` section; solved by MIP linearization, or by OR-Tools CP-SAT with `mip_engine=cpsat` when installed (`rusolve-cli version --format json` shows `cpsat.available`); checked on the objects, `sol.cp["verified"]`; no MPS/LP syntax).

## Problem classes beyond LP and MIP

`rusolve-cli mip model --format json` (and `solve`) routes by class; the envelope has `class` and `engine`. A class nothing solves exits 3 with a typed error that names the class.

- **Convex QP** (`convex_qp`, engine `hipo` or `quass`): quadratic objective `c'x + 1/2 x'Qx`, linear rows, continuous. [Playbook](docs/skills/convex-qp/SKILL.md).
- **SOCP, rotated cones, convex QCQP** (`conic`, engine `clarabel`): quadratic rows (`[ x ^ 2 + y ^ 2 ] <= 1` in an LP file) and cones (`CSECTION ... QUAD|RQUAD` in MPS), continuous. Answers carry a checker verdict, row and cone duals, and verified infeasibility or unboundedness certificates. [Playbook](docs/skills/conic/SKILL.md).
- **Convex MIQP** (`miqp`, engine `oa`): a convex Q with integer columns. Experimental, off by default because it is slower; enable with `--opt miqp_oa=true` (MCP `solve` option `miqp_oa`). [Design](docs/design/miqp-oa.md), [playbook](docs/skills/convex-qp/SKILL.md).
- **Mixed-integer SOCP and convex MIQCQP** (`mi_conic`, engine `oa`): cones or convex quadratic rows with integer columns. Experimental, off by default because it is slower; enable with `--opt misocp_oa=true` (MCP `solve` option `misocp_oa`). [Design](docs/design/misocp-oa.md), [playbook](docs/skills/conic/SKILL.md).
- **General constraints** (`gc`, `gc_mip`, engine `gc-linearization`): indicator, SOS, piecewise-linear, min/max/abs, and/or/not, semi-continuous. [Playbook](docs/skills/piecewise-semi/SKILL.md).
- Refused with a typed error: `nonconvex_qp`, `nonconvex_qcqp`, a nonconvex Q with integers, general constraints together with quadratic terms (`gc_quadratic`).

## Contracts

- [JSON schemas](docs/schema): one `rusolve-<command>-1.schema.json` per command output; `schema_version` is `rusolve.<command>/1`.
- [Diagnostics contract](docs/design/diagnostics.md): rustc-style diagnostics with registered codes on every error path.
- [MIP hook points](docs/design/hooks.md): the extension API for cuts, branching and node selection.
- [Agent-task evals](evals/README.md): how well an agent drives the solver, graded against the solver's own answers.

## Optional

- [Option registry rows](docs/agent/reference.md#options): every option (HiGHS's own and rusolve's additions), each marked `search`, `tolerance`, `runtime` or `output`.
- [Literature the techniques come from](docs/literature.md)
